name: Striven
description_en:
Striven is Miles IT’s business-management suite connecting accounting, inventory, sales/CRM, projects, people and portals. This profile focuses on the inventory-to-accounting workflow and the current user/portal pricing structure.

The platform offers stocked, non-inventory, kit and manufactured item records, but that does not establish every production-planning requirement. No account, warehouse transfer, report or portal permission was tested. The trial’s exact duration and contract terms remain unverified.
description_zh:
Striven 是 Miles IT 的业务管理套件，连接会计、库存、销售 CRM、项目、人员和门户。本文聚焦库存会计流程及当前用户门户计费。

平台提供库存、非库存、套件和制造物品记录，不代表覆盖所有生产规划要求。未测试账户、仓库调拨、报表或门户权限；试用确切期限及合同仍未核实。

core_features.explanation_en: Track locations, bins, transfers, lots/serials and stock changes linked to receiving and selling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪地点货位、调拨、批次序列号和收销引起的库存变化。

core_features.explanation_en: The product describes inventory valuation feeding financial statements in the same system.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品介绍库存估值在同一系统进入财务报表。

core_features.explanation_en: Customer, vendor and career portal allowances are priced separately from internal users.
core_features.explanation_zh: 客户、供应商和招聘门户额度与内部用户分别定价。

pricing.billing_basis: Standard/Enterprise internal users, under-five surcharge and separately priced portal tiers; currency code not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly $35/$70 per user plus $25/user below five. Portal tiers separately free/99/499 at documented allowances.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 用户月费 $35/$70，不足五人每用户另加 $25；门户按额度另列免费、99、499 三级。

sources.title: Inventory Management | Striven
sources.research_notes_en: Warehouse/bin, costing, item types, replenishment and accounting links; production depth not inferred.

sources.title: Pricing | User-Based, Simple and Affordable | Striven
sources.research_notes_en: Monthly user rates, under-five surcharge and per-portal allowances/price units; trial conditions not inferred.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Compare physical movement with financial value
sections.title_zh: 对照实物移动和财务价值
sections.en:
The inventory page describes automatic updates for receipts, sales, transfers and builds, multiple warehouses/mobile locations, bins and lot/serial tracking. It lists FIFO, LIFO and average costing as supported methods; choosing an appropriate accounting policy still belongs to the business and its accountant.

For a hypothetical two-location seller, receive ten items, transfer three and sell one. Inspect source/destination quantity, valuation and the related financial records, then process a return. These are proposed tests, not executed ledger evidence or proof that all valuations remain correct automatically.
sections.zh:
库存页介绍收货、销售、调拨和组装后的更新，多仓库移动地点、货位及批次序列号，并列出先进先出、后进先出和平均计价；合适的会计政策仍需企业会计决定。

可假设两个地点的商家收十件、调三件、卖一件，检查来源目标数量、估值和财务记录，再处理退货。这是建议测试，不是已执行总账证据，也不保证所有估值自动正确。

sections.title_en: Replenishment rules need maintained item data
sections.title_zh: 补货规则需要维护物品资料
sections.en:
The product describes low-stock thresholds, purchase orders from sales orders, contract-based purchasing, custom item attributes and stocked/kit/manufactured types. A purchase suggestion should be inspected against demand, open supply and the chosen location.

Test a shortage, duplicate receipt and lot-specific return, and identify who can change unit, cost or a completed transaction. An item type labeled manufactured does not prove a factory routing, capacity model or regulated traceability implementation. Those deeper requirements remain outside the verified scope of the pages read.
sections.zh:
产品介绍低库存阈值、销售单转采购、合同采购、自定义物品属性及库存套件制造类型。补货建议应结合需求、未到供货和具体地点检查。

可测试缺货、重复收货和指定批次退货，并明确谁能改单位、成本或完结交易。“制造”物品类型不证明已具备工厂路线、产能模型或受监管追溯实施，这些深层要求仍超出已读页面核实范围。

sections.title_en: Small-team pricing has an explicit surcharge
sections.title_zh: 小团队价格有明确附加费
sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 lists monthly Standard at $35/user and Enterprise at $70/user, with an additional $25/user for fewer than five users. Thus a hypothetical four-user Standard team is $240 monthly in listed components, while five actual Standard users are $175, before other charges. Confirm the appropriate real user count rather than assuming linear pricing at $35.

The page separately offers each customer/vendor/career portal free up to its listed 100 allowance, $99 monthly up to 500 and $499 for unlimited. Career limits concern applications per month. A free portal tier does not establish a free internal ERP plan; currency code, checkout and full plan limits were not established.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页列出 Standard 每用户月费 $35、Enterprise $70；不足五用户另加每用户 $25。因此假设四个 Standard 用户，展示组成合计每月 $240，而五个真实用户为 $175，尚未计其他费用。应确认真实所需人数，不能按 $35 线性推算。

页面另为每个客户供应商招聘门户提供所列 100 额度内免费、500 以内月费 $99、不限 $499；招聘限制是每月申请数。免费门户不代表内部 ERP 免费，币种代码、结账和完整套餐限制未确立。

sections.title_en: Separate internal control from external collaboration
sections.title_zh: 区分内部控制和外部协作
sections.en:
Prepare charts/opening balances, item units, warehouses, customer/vendor records and portal roles. Reconcile one complete receipt/sale/return cycle and verify an external customer cannot see another customer’s records. These are editorial acceptance suggestions; portal isolation was not tested.

Striven is worth investigating where a smaller organization wants connected operations and finance. Exact Standard/Enterprise capability differences, license rights, integrations, regional filings and recovery should be confirmed before adoption. The pricing page offers training material and support, but that does not establish migration or custom implementation costs. No claimed savings or ease-of-use rating was measured.
sections.zh:
应准备科目期初、物品单位、仓库、客户供应商及门户角色，对清完整收销退周期，并确认外部客户不能看另一客户记录。这是编辑验收建议，本文未测试门户隔离。

较小组织需要连接运营财务时可调查 Striven。采用前应确认 Standard/Enterprise 具体能力差别、许可、集成、地区申报及恢复。定价页提供培训资料和支持，不等于已确立迁移或定制实施费；本文未测节省或易用性评分。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Plan-specific capability limits, ISO currency, trial duration, licensing, implementation and regional filing scope need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 套餐能力限制、ISO 币种、试用期限、许可、实施和地区申报范围需确认。

research_gaps.en: No stock/ledger transaction, portal isolation, connector, migration, export or restore was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试库存总账交易、门户隔离、连接器、迁移、导出或恢复。
